python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re, math
with open('/tmp/dom.html') as f:
    html = f.read()

# Parse all circles with their attrs
circles = re.findall(r'<circle class="bubble" r="([^"]+)" fill="([^"]+)" stroke="[^"]+" stroke-width="[^"]+" cx="([^"]+)" cy="([^"]+)"', html)
print(f'Total circles: {len(circles)}')
xs = [float(c[2]) for c in circles]
ys = [float(c[3]) for c in circles]
rs = [float(c[0]) for c in circles]
print(f'X range: {min(xs):.1f} - {max(xs):.1f}')
print(f'Y range: {min(ys):.1f} - {max(ys):.1f}')
print(f'R range: {min(rs):.2f} - {max(rs):.2f}')

# Check overlap count
overlaps = 0
for i in range(len(circles)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(circles)):
        dx = float(circles[i][2]) - float(circles[j][2])
        dy = float(circles[i][3]) - float(circles[j][3])
        dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
        rad_sum = float(circles[i][0]) + float(circles[j][0])
        if dist < rad_sum - 1:  # allow 1px tolerance
            overlaps += 1
print(f'Strict overlaps (<r1+r2 - 1): {overlaps}')

# Check labels
labels = re.findall(r'<text class="bubble-label" x="([^"]+)" y="([^"]+)" font-size="[^"]+">([^<]+)</text>', html)
print(f'Total labels: {len(labels)}')
PYEOF
